policy: Read-only24file residual decoding with a pinned first-party observer. Actual consumed bits split into group32bit ANS initialization,16bit normalization reads, exact hybrid extra bits and zero padding; every remaining section bit reconciles. Inverse-transformed planes reproduce every original color/alpha sample with complete nonduplicate coverage. Transformed channel indices reflect each fixed local RCT; physical normalization bits follow decoder order and are not an independent code length for that channel. Serialized-frequency ideal token costs and empirical entropies are estimates, kept separate from actual bytes. No encode, timing, source/cost/package or full-parity adoption.
